rationales.authenticity: Thyme and honey are period-appropriate remedies, but presentation is straightforward without period flavor.
rationales.character: Competent healer, sympathetic tone, but lacks the particular voice of Brigid.
rationales.craft: Three sentences, practical and clear, but somewhat didactic; lacks evocative detail.
rationales.language: Well-formed English with 'so it is' Irish inflection; clear and grammatically sound.
rationales.responsiveness: Directly answers with a specific remedy and actionable advice.
